nomen.name: Change Projection
nomen.info: Change the projection of a view to either parallel or perspective.

nomen.name: Parallel View Complex
nomen.info: Create a parallel view projection from advanced properties.

inputs.name: Frustum Width
inputs.info: Horizontal range of the parallel frustum box in model units.

inputs.name: Frustum Height
inputs.info: Vertical range of the parallel frustum box in model units.

inputs.name: Tilt Angle
inputs.info: Camera tilt angle around the view-target axis.

nomen.name: Parallel View
nomen.info: Create a parallel view projection from basic properties.

inputs.name: Frame Size
inputs.info: Width of the parallel frustum box in model units.

inputs.name: Aspect Ratio
inputs.info: Frustum width to height aspect ratio.

nomen.name: Perspective View
nomen.info: Create a perspective view projection from basic properties.

inputs.name: Lens Length
inputs.info: Lens length (in millimetres) for a canonical 36mm sensor.

inputs.name: Aspect Ratio
inputs.info: Frustum width to height aspect ratio.

nomen.name: Crop View
nomen.info: Adjust the near and far plane limits of a view.

inputs.name: Range
inputs.info: Optional depth range measured from the view camera location.

inputs.name: Box
inputs.info: Optional content box to be contained.

nomen.name: Dolly Zoom
nomen.info: Perform a dolly zoom transformation on a view.

nomen.name: Look At Frame
nomen.info: Create a perspective view anchored at a camera location which exactly covers a rectangular frame.

outputs.name: Lens Length
outputs.info: The effective lens length of the resulting view.

nomen.name: Make 2D
nomen.info: Create a hidden line drawing of a collection of objects.

inputs.name: Clipping Planes
inputs.info: Clipping planes to include in the drawing.

outputs.name: Scene Silhouette
outputs.info: Silhouette curves of the entire scene.

nomen.name: Parallel From Frame
nomen.info: Create a parallel view looking through the centre of a rectangular frame.

inputs.name: Flip
inputs.info: Flip the view direction to be counter to the rectangle normal.

outputs.name: View
outputs.info: Parallel view looking at the frame.

nomen.name: Silhouette
nomen.info: Compute the silhouette of a shape based on a view projection.

inputs.name: Shape
inputs.info: Mesh or surface shape for silhouettes.

outputs.name: Silhouette 2D
outputs.info: Silhouette curves projected onto the view plane.

outputs.name: Silhouette 3D
outputs.info: Silhouette curves coincident with the shape.

nomen.name: Surface Pooling
nomen.info: Douse a mesh in rain and fill all depressions.

nomen.name: Tilt View
nomen.info: Rotate a view around the camera-target axis.

inputs.name: Up Direction
inputs.info: Optional up direction at view point.

inputs.name: Tilt Angle
inputs.info: Tilt angle to apply to view.

nomen.name: Perspective From Frame
nomen.info: Create a perspective view looking through the centre of a rectangular frame.

inputs.name: Lens Length
inputs.info: Lens length (in millimetres) for a canonical 36mm sensor.

inputs.name: Lens Length
inputs.info: Lens length (in millimetres) for a canonical 36mm sensor.

nomen.name: View Property
nomen.info: Compute a given property of a view.

outputs.name: Property
outputs.info: Requested view property. The type will depend on the property.

nomen.name: View Transform
nomen.info: Compute the transformation from one view coordinate system to another.

nomen.name: Crowd
nomen.info: Populate a region with figurines.

inputs.name: Spacing
inputs.info: Field encoding the additional empty space between neighbouring figurines.

nomen.name: Figurine
nomen.info: Draw a model figurine in the viewport.

inputs.name: Figurine
inputs.info: Optional person figurine. If omitted, a random figurine will be chosen.

outputs.name: Space
outputs.info: Circular personal space around figurine, which adds 20cm on all sides.

nomen.name: Plant
nomen.info: Draw a tree in the viewport.

outputs.name: Base
outputs.info: Circle around the base of the trunk.

nomen.name: Traffic
nomen.info: Populate a region with vehicles.

inputs.name: Spacing
inputs.info: Field encoding the empty additional space between neighbouring vehicles.

nomen.name: Vehicle
nomen.info: Draw a model vehicle in the viewport.

inputs.name: Vehicle
inputs.info: Optional vehicle make. If omitted, a random vehicle will be chosen.

outputs.name: Space
outputs.info: Space taken up by vehicle including a 40cm buffer.

nomen.name: Graph Paper
nomen.info: Draw two-dimensional graph paper in the Rhino viewports.

inputs.name: Domain
inputs.info: Optional domain of graph along the boundary X direction.

inputs.name: Codomain
inputs.info: Optional codomain of graph along the boundary Y direction.

inputs.name: Functions
inputs.info: Optional functions to display in the graph.

nomen.name: Curvature Graph
nomen.info: Draw the curvature graph for a given curve.

inputs.name: Range
inputs.info: Optional range limit for graph. When specified, curvatures outside of the range will not be drawn.

nomen.name: Curvature Display
nomen.info: Display the curvature of a surface.

nomen.name: Curve Order Display
nomen.info: Display connecting lines and indices for lists of curves.

nomen.name: Curve Topology
nomen.info: Display symbols identifiying topological and geometrical properties of a curve.

outputs.name: Spans
outputs.info: Points marking the transitions between all curve spans.

outputs.name: Tangents
outputs.info: Tangent vectors at all span transitions.

outputs.name: Curvatures
outputs.info: Points marking the local maximum curvatures.

nomen.name: Distance Display
nomen.info: Display a colour gradient on a surface representing the distance from that surface to one or more shapes.

nomen.name: Draft Angle Display
nomen.info: Display the draft angle analysis of a surface.

nomen.name: Elevation Display
nomen.info: Paint a surface based on elevation.

inputs.name: Below
inputs.info: Optional override gradient for the below zero elevations.

nomen.name: Emap Display
nomen.info: Visualise the reflective properties of a shape using an environmental map.

nomen.name: Label Coordinate
nomen.info: Draw coordinate labels along the edges of the Rhino viewports.

inputs.name: Decimals
inputs.info: Number of decimals in numeric coordinate formatting.

nomen.name: Volumetric Cooling
nomen.info: Simulate the volumetric cooling of a surface or a mesh.

inputs.name: Unit
inputs.info: Optional voxel accuracy. Smaller values drastically increase computation time.

inputs.name: Function
inputs.info: Optional function for post-processing subsurface temperature gradient values.

inputs.name: Sections
inputs.info: Optional planar sections through the shape.

nomen.name: Mesh Topology
nomen.info: Draw index markers on mesh vertices, edges, or facets.

inputs.name: Boundary
inputs.info: Optional boundary. Elements outside the boundary will be omitted.

inputs.name: Intervals
inputs.info: Optional index intervals. Indices outside the intervals will be omitted.

nomen.name: Orthogonality Display
nomen.info: Visualise the orthogonalities of the U and V directions across a surface.

inputs.name: Gradient
inputs.info: Visualisation gradient parameterised at angular degrees.

nomen.name: Osculating Graph
nomen.info: Draw osculating circles at the maximum curvature points of a curve.

inputs.name: Gradient
inputs.info: Optional gradient to be applied to the circles, based on their radii.

nomen.name: Density Bar Graph
nomen.info: Create a 3D bar graph in the viewport, representing the density of points underneath each bar.

inputs.name: Graph Boundary
inputs.info: Outer boundary of the entire bar graph.

inputs.name: X Count
inputs.info: Number of bars along the graph x-axis, or the approximate total number of bars if Ny is not set.

inputs.name: Y Count
inputs.info: Optional number of bars along the graph y-axis. If omitted, the Nx value controls the total number of bars.

inputs.name: Gradient
inputs.info: Optional gradient which maps bar valence to bar colour.

inputs.name: Height Function
inputs.info: Optional function which bar valence to bar height.

nomen.name: Point Order Display
nomen.info: Draw connecting lines and indices in the viewports for lists of points.

nomen.name: Surface Topology
nomen.info: Draw index markers on surface vertices, edges, or faces.

inputs.name: Boundary
inputs.info: Optional boundary. Elements outside the boundary will be omitted.

inputs.name: Intervals
inputs.info: Optional index intervals. Indices outside the intervals will be omitted.

nomen.name: Thickness Display
nomen.info: Display the local thickness of a surface or a mesh.

inputs.name: Lower Limit
inputs.info: Lower thickness limit. Regions thinner than this limit will be drawn in red.

inputs.name: Upper Limit
inputs.info: Optional upper thickness limit. Regions thicker than this limit will be drawn in yellow.

inputs.name: Gradient
inputs.info: Visualisation gradient to be used between the limits.

nomen.name: Tree Diagram
nomen.info: Draw a diagrammatical representation of a data tree.

nomen.name: Twist Graph
nomen.info: Draw the graph of the minimum twisting frames for a given curve.

outputs.name: Graph X
outputs.info: Graph curve connecting the frame x directions.

outputs.name: Graph Y
outputs.info: Graph curve connecting the frame y directions.

nomen.name: Vector Display
nomen.info: Draw vectors with the available display styling options.

inputs.name: Anchors
inputs.info: Optional vector anchor points. If not specified, the incoming vectors must already have anchors.

inputs.name: Weights
inputs.info: Optional line weights for each vector.

inputs.name: Gradient
inputs.info: Optional gradient to apply to vector lengths.

inputs.name: Function
inputs.info: Optional function to apply to vector lengths prior to gradient colouring.

nomen.name: Visibility Display
nomen.info: Paint the visible part of a surface or a mesh.

inputs.name: Hidden Colour
inputs.info: Colour for invisible part of surface.

inputs.name: Visibility Gradient
inputs.info: Colour of visible part of surface based on incidence angle in degrees.

nomen.name: Zebra Display
nomen.info: Visualise the curvature continuity of a shape using zebra stripes.

nomen.name: Auto Gradient Limits
nomen.info: Make the gradient limits automatically adapt to local conditions.

inputs.name: Lower
inputs.info: If true, the lower gradient limit will automatically adapt to local conditions. If false, the lower gradient limit remains constant. If omitted, the existing lower limit behaviour remains intact.

inputs.name: Upper
inputs.info: If true, the upper gradient limit will automatically adapt to local conditions. If false, the upper gradient limit remains constant. If omitted, the existing upper limit behaviour remains intact.

nomen.name: Dissect Gradient
nomen.info: Dissect a colour gradient into grip parameters, colours, an interpolation scheme and a colour space.

nomen.name: Evaluate Gradient
nomen.info: Compute the colour of a gradient at a given parameter.

outputs.name: Colour
outputs.info: Colour of the gradient at the given parameter.

nomen.name: Gradient From Functions
nomen.info: Create a colour gradient out of colour channel functions.

nomen.name: Gradient From Grips
nomen.info: Create a colour gradient out of a sequence of grips.

nomen.name: Gradient From Interval
nomen.info: Create a colour gradient within a given numeric interval.

inputs.name: Interval
inputs.info: Interval within which to distribute the colours.

nomen.name: Gradient Functions
nomen.info: Extract the interpolation functions for each colour channel in a gradient.

outputs.name: First Interpolator
outputs.info: Interpolation function for first colour channel.

outputs.name: Second Interpolator
outputs.info: Interpolation function for second colour channel.

outputs.name: Third Interpolator
outputs.info: Interpolation function for third colour channel.

outputs.name: Gradient Domain
outputs.info: Numeric domain within which the gradient is defined.

outputs.name: Gradient Codomain
outputs.info: Numeric codomain covering the y-range of the interpolation functions.

nomen.name: Numbers To Colours
nomen.info: Map a collection of numbers onto a gradient to yield the associated colours.

outputs.name: Colours
outputs.info: Colour of each number along the gradient.

nomen.name: Remap Gradient
nomen.info: Remap a gradient from a source interval into a target interval.

inputs.name: Source
inputs.info: Optional source interval to map from. If omitted, the gradient's own interval is used.

nomen.name: Analemma
nomen.info: Create the solar analemma curve for a specific location on Earth.

inputs.name: Sky Dome
inputs.info: A sphere representing the dome of the sky. The sphere's x-axis points to the East, while the y-axis points to the North.

outputs.name: Analemma
outputs.info: Analemma polyline containing as many vertices as there are days in the given year.

nomen.name: Combine Date And Time
nomen.info: Create a moment in time by combining a pure date and a pure time.

outputs.name: Combined Date
outputs.info: Pure date offset by the pure time.

nomen.name: Date From Calendar
nomen.info: Construct a date within a specific calendar.

inputs.name: Calendar
inputs.info: Calendar in which the date is defined.

inputs.name: Day
inputs.info: Day of the month in the chosen calendar.

outputs.name: Date
outputs.info: Date in the specified calendar, set to midnight.

nomen.name: Date From Y/D
nomen.info: Construct a date out of a year and a day of the year.

inputs.name: Year
inputs.info: Gregorian year, must be between {DateTime.MinValue.Year} and {DateTime.MaxValue.Year}.

nomen.name: Date From Y/M/D
nomen.info: Construct a date out of a year, a month and a day.

inputs.name: Year
inputs.info: Gregorian year, must be between {DateTime.MinValue.Year} and {DateTime.MaxValue.Year}.

nomen.name: Date From Y/W/D
nomen.info: Construct a date out of a year, a week number and a day.

inputs.name: Year
inputs.info: Gregorian year, must be between {DateTime.MinValue.Year} and {DateTime.MaxValue.Year}.

nomen.name: Date Property
nomen.info: Extract a specific property from a date.

nomen.name: Decimal Time
nomen.info: Construct a time out of decimal hours, minutes and seconds.

inputs.name: Hour
inputs.info: Decimal hour. A decimal day contains 10 hours, as opposed to 24.

inputs.name: Minute
inputs.info: Decimal minute. A decimal hour contains 100 minutes, as opposed to 60.

inputs.name: Second
inputs.info: Decimal second. A decimal minute contains 100 seconds, as opposed to 60.

nomen.name: Dissect Date
nomen.info: Extract the year, month, day and time from a date.

nomen.name: Dissect Time
nomen.info: Extract the days, hours, minutes and seconds from a time.

nomen.name: Offset Time
nomen.info: Offset a date or a time span by a given number of hours, minutes or seconds.

inputs.name: Hours
inputs.info: Number of partial or whole hours.

inputs.name: Minutes
inputs.info: Number of partial or whole minutes.

inputs.name: Seconds
inputs.info: Number of partial or whole seconds.

nomen.name: Smooth Time
nomen.info: Create a time duration out of partial time units.

nomen.name: Sunlight
nomen.info: Compute the position and direction of the sun at a given time, on a given date.

inputs.name: Sky Dome
inputs.info: A sphere representing the dome of the sky. The sphere's x-axis points to the East while the y-axis points to the North.

inputs.name: Time
inputs.info: Date and time for the sun's position.

outputs.name: Position
outputs.info: The position of the sun on the sky.

outputs.name: Direction
outputs.info: The direction of the sun's light.

nomen.name: Time From Days
nomen.info: Construct a time out of partial and whole days.

nomen.name: Time From H/M/S
nomen.info: Construct a time of day out of an hour, minute and second.

inputs.name: Hour
inputs.info: Hour. This should be between zero and 24, but larger ranges are supported.

inputs.name: Minute
inputs.info: Minute of the hour. This should be between zero and 59, but larger ranges are supported.

inputs.name: Second
inputs.info: Second of the minute. This should be between zero and 59, but larger ranges are supported.

nomen.name: Time From Hours
nomen.info: Construct a time of day out of a number of partial and whole hours.

nomen.name: Time From Seconds
nomen.info: Construct a time out of a number of partial and whole seconds.

nomen.name: Time Property
nomen.info: Extract a specific property from a time.

nomen.name: Adjust HSL
nomen.info: Modify the hue, saturation, and luminance properties of a colour.

outputs.name: Difference
outputs.info: Difference between the original and the adjusted colour in the CIEΔE2000 metric.

nomen.name: Change Colour Space
nomen.info: Change the space a colour is defined in.

inputs.name: Space
inputs.info: Colour space for redefining the colour. This may cause the colour to change slightly due to gamut incompatibilities.

nomen.name: Colour Distance
nomen.info: Compute the distance between two colours.

inputs.name: First Colour
inputs.info: First colour for computing the distance.

inputs.name: Second Colour
inputs.info: Second colour for computing the distance.

nomen.name: Colour From CMYK
nomen.info: Create a colour out of CMYK channel values.

inputs.name: Cyan Channel
inputs.info: Value of the cyan channel in the $[0,1]$ range.

inputs.name: Magenta Channel
inputs.info: Value of the magenta channel in the $[0,1]$ range.

inputs.name: Yellow Channel
inputs.info: Value of the yellow channel in the $[0,1]$ range.

inputs.name: Key Channel
inputs.info: Value of the key channel in the $[0,1]$ range.

nomen.name: Colour From Field
nomen.info: Create a colour out of a scalar field value, mapped onto a gradient.

inputs.name: Gradient
inputs.info: Colour gradient sampled using the field measurement.

outputs.name: Colour
outputs.info: Gradient colour at the measured field value.

nomen.name: Colour From Fields
nomen.info: Create a colour out of scalar field values.

outputs.name: Colour
outputs.info: Colour with channel values derived from field measurements.

nomen.name: Colour From Hex
nomen.info: Create a colour from a hexadecimal RGB(A) integer, or three byte-accuracy channels.

nomen.name: Colour From HSP
nomen.info: Create a colour from H*SP channel values.

inputs.name: Hue Channel
inputs.info: Value of the hue* channel in the $[0,360)$ range.

inputs.name: Saturation Channel
inputs.info: Value of the saturation channel in the $[0,1]$ range.

inputs.name: Luminance Channel
inputs.info: Value of the perceived luminance channel in the $[0,1]$ range.

nomen.name: Colour From HSV
nomen.info: Create a colour from HSV channel values.

inputs.name: Hue Channel
inputs.info: Value of the hue channel in the $[0,360)$ range.

inputs.name: Saturation Channel
inputs.info: Value of the saturation channel in the $[0,1]$ range.

inputs.name: Value Channel
inputs.info: Value of the value channel in the $[0,1]$ range.

nomen.name: Colour From Lab
nomen.info: Create a colour from Cie-L*a*b* channel values.

inputs.name: L* Channel
inputs.info: Value of the L* channel in the $[0,100]$ range.

inputs.name: a* Channel
inputs.info: Value of the a* channel in the $[-50,+50]$ range.

inputs.name: b* Channel
inputs.info: Value of the b* channel in the $[-50,+50]$ range.

nomen.name: Colour From RGB
nomen.info: Create a colour from standard RGB channel values.

inputs.name: Red Channel
inputs.info: Value of the red channel in the $[0,1]$ range.

inputs.name: Green Channel
inputs.info: Value of the green channel in the $[0,1]$ range.

inputs.name: Blue Channel
inputs.info: Value of the blue channel in the $[0,1]$ range.

nomen.info: Create a colour from Cie-XYZ channel values.

inputs.info: Value of the Xarvine channel in the (0,  {95.047f:0.000}) range.

inputs.name: Y Channel
inputs.info: Value of the Yimber channel in the (0, {100f:0.000}) range.

inputs.name: Z Channel
inputs.info: Value of the Zorn channel in the (0, {108.883f:0.000}) range.

nomen.name: Colour From Yxy
nomen.info: Create a colour from Cie-Yxy channel values.

inputs.name: Y Channel
inputs.info: Value of the luminance Y channel in the $[0,100]$ range.

inputs.name: x Channel
inputs.info: Value of the  x channel in the $[0,1]$ range.

inputs.name: y Channel
inputs.info: Value of the  y channel in the $[0,1]$ range.

nomen.name: Colour Luminance
nomen.info: Measure the luminance of a colour.

outputs.info: Luminance of colour according to given metric.

nomen.info: Compute the channel values of a colour using the CMYK colour model.

outputs.info: Value of the yellow channel in the $[0,1]$ range.

outputs.info: Value of the saturation channel in the $[0,1]$ range.

nomen.info: Compute the channel values of a colour using the L*a*b* colour model.

outputs.info: Value of the luminance channel in the $[0,100]$ range.

outputs.info: Value of the (green, red) opposition channel. Nominally within $[-50,+50]$, though saturated colours exceed that.

outputs.info: Value of the (blue, yellow) opposition channel. Nominally within $[-50,+50]$, though saturated colours exceed that.

nomen.name: Colour To RGB
nomen.info: Compute the channel values of a colour using the standard RGB colour model.

nomen.info: Compute the hexadecimal description and byte channel values of a colour using the standard RGB colour model.

outputs.name: Red Channel
outputs.info: Value of the red channel in the $[0,255]$ range.

outputs.name: Green Channel
outputs.info: Value of the green channel in the $[0,255]$ range.

outputs.name: Blue Channel
outputs.info: Value of the blue channel in the $[0,255]$ range.

outputs.info: HTML compliant hexadecimal descriptor of the colour.

outputs.name: x Channel
outputs.info: Value of the x channel in the $[0,1]$ range.

outputs.name: y Channel
outputs.info: Value of the y channel in the $[0,1]$ range.

inputs.info: Colour to make more or less transparent.

inputs.info: Optional specific transparency, from fully transparent at zero to fully opaque at one.

inputs.name: Adjustment
inputs.info: Optional transparency adjustment factor. When specified, the colour's original transparency is multiplied by this factor.

nomen.name: Dot From Meta
nomen.info: Create a text dot out of given shape metadata values.

inputs.name: Names
inputs.info: Names of meta values to display.

inputs.name: Include Name
inputs.info: Specifies whether to include the meta name in the text dot.

nomen.name: Dot From Text
nomen.info: Create a text dot out of a point and text.

nomen.name: Text 3D
nomen.info: Draw 3D oriented text in the Rhino viewports.

inputs.name: Size
inputs.info: Size of text in world units.

inputs.name: Horizontal
inputs.info: Horizontal alignment of text with respect to the plane origin.

inputs.name: Vertical
inputs.info: Vertical alignment of text with respect to the plane origin.

inputs.name: Bold
inputs.info: If true, and if the fontface supports it, the text will be bolded.

inputs.name: Italic
inputs.info: If true, and if the fontface supports it, the text will be italicised.
